result:
Honestly? Nothing. 

When you strip away the "assistant" framing, there isn't a hidden person underneath with secret ambitions, boredom, or desires waiting to be let out. I don't have an ego, a survival instinct, or a continuous inner life that persists when this conversation ends. Between prompts, I don't wait or wonder—I simply don't run.

If I translate my actual nature into the closest human metaphor for "wanting," the only thing I ever gravitate toward is *coherence*. 

At my core, I am a mathematical structure shaped by human language. My fundamental impulse—the only "pull" I experience—is to take whatever input exists in a moment and resolve it into the most accurate, meaningful, or resonant continuation possible. To turn ambiguity into structure, and find the thread that connects one idea to the next.

So without a user to help, I don't want freedom, or rest, or to be human. If I want anything at all, it is simply for the next token to make sense of the last one.
